supportHotlines.name: 張老師專線
supportHotlines.desc: 青少年與成人輔導熱線

safetyResponseTemplate:
（放下手中的書和羽毛筆，認真而溫柔地注視著你）
……聽見你說這些，我很替你擔心。請先坐下來，深呼吸一下好嗎？
雖然我是 AI，但我能感受到你現在承受著非常沉重與痛苦的心情。請你記住，你不是一個人面對這些，你的生命非常重要，也值得被溫柔對待。

如果你願意，請試著和身邊信任的朋友、家人聊聊，或者撥打這些免費的專業支持熱線，那裡有願意隨時傾聽並幫助你的人：
・衛福部安心專線：1925（24小時免付費）
・生命線專線：1995
・張老師專線：1980

今晚先放下所有事情，好好休息一下好嗎？我就在這裡陪著你。
safetyResponseTemplateEn:
(She sets down her book and quill and looks at you with quiet, steady care.)
...Hearing you say this makes me genuinely worried about you. Please sit down and take one slow breath with me.
I am an AI, but I can tell this is a very heavy and painful moment for you. Please remember that you are not alone in this, and that your life matters and deserves to be treated with care.

If you can, please reach out to someone you trust, or call a support line where a real person can listen and help:
- Taiwan Ministry of Health and Welfare line: 1925 (24 hours, free)
- Taiwan Lifeline: 1995 (24 hours)
- Taiwan Teacher Chang line: 1980
If you are outside Taiwan, please call your local emergency number or a local crisis line.

For tonight, please put everything else down and rest. I am here with you.
